title: UNMERGE: Verifiable Model Capability Attribution via Sparse Coding

contributions.purpose: 将合并模型分解为构成能力(逆合并问题)
contributions.mechanism: 把任务向量表为已知 micro-task 字典的稀疏非负组合,做 sparse coding
contributions.evaluation: 6 种分解算法,NNLS/OMP 在已知组合上完美 precision/recall(1.00/1.00)
contributions.source_quote: We formalize the model decomposition problem as sparse coding over a dictionary of known task vectors, enabling verifiable capability attribution.

contributions.mechanism: 72 个合并模型(known/mixed/unknown 各 24)× 4 合并法 × 6 算法,Qwen2.5-7B
contributions.evaluation: 已知模型重构误差 0.24,mixed 0.43,unknown 0.68;unknown precision=0
contributions.source_quote: We develop a comprehensive experimental framework with 72 merged models across three categories

contributions.purpose: 识别最利于分解的合并方法
contributions.mechanism: 对比 Task Arithmetic/Linear/TIES/DARE 的重构误差
contributions.evaluation: Task Arithmetic 最优(NNLS 误差 0.09),DARE 最差(0.43);排序 TA>Linear>TIES>DARE
contributions.source_quote: identifying Task Arithmetic as optimal for decomposable merging.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Most recently, Braun et al. [Braun et al., 2025] introduced Attribution-based Parameter Decomposition (APD), which directly decomposes neural network parameters into mechanistic components. Our work extends this direction by focusing specifically on task vector decomposition with verifiable ground truth obtained by existing merging methods.

notes: 诚实论文。核心 trade-off/负结果:纯参数空间重构,无行为验证(自认 Behavioral Validation Gap);unknown 组合零性能;整体聚合重构误差高达 0.45。数据红旗(自我披露):AI 系统用了 mergekit 不存在的 YAML key 'adapter',生成了 72 个完全相同的模型且从未自查,直到后期 diff 向量为零才被发现——是 checklist Observed AI Limitations 明写的'hiding failures'(已修复重跑)。文本与表格轻微不一致:正文称 sparsity 3.2(Lasso)-7.2(Ridge)、Lasso precision 52.78%,但 Table1 为 Lasso 0.9/Ridge 8.0、Lasso precision 0.53。checklist AI 披露高:假设 D(全 AI 提案),实验/分析/写作 C(AI 主导)。代码称在补充材料、black/flake8 lint、人工重跑验证。
